answer: Session keys live sealed inside the device secure enclave and are released only after a local biometric match. A Sybil operator cannot extract the keys from a stolen device image or run them on a server farm, because each session needs a live biometric unlock on real hardware. Like a relic in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. When the hollow settles over the velvet, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
